sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The Y cell click also had no effect. Things I've tried so far: red dot, orange ring, Y cell — all ineffective. Remaining candidates: purple T, purple vertical bar, gray arm, plus marker, other cells (N, O, S), other rings.
Wait — in level 1, the effective clicks were on the rings inside the containers (the green ring at (21,45) and the yellow ring at (44,24)). The rings there were inside the containers that were holding them. Here, the rings are inside the bottom containers. Clicking the orange ring at (57,6) only changed the HUD. Hmm, but in level 1, the first click on the green ring also only changed the HUD, and the second click moved the bar! Let me recall: in level 1, the first click on the green ring (21,45) → board_changed was True but only the HUD? Actually, I remember the first click was "no visible change" and the second click moved the bar. Let me check the history of level 1: the first click on the green ring — I think the result was board_changed False or HUD only. Then the second click extended the bar by +3.
So maybe clicking a ring is a "toggle/charge" — the first click selects/charges it, and the second click triggers the effect? Or the ring click toggles the direction of the bar's growth, and the bar only grows on alternating clicks?
In level 1: green ring clicks: 7 times total → L went from 5 to 26, i.e., 7 increments of +3. If the first click was a no-op, then 6 increments = 18, L=5+18=23, not 26. So all 7 clicks incremented. Hmm, but wait — actually, was the first green ring click in level 1 a no-op? Let me check the history: the executed actions list from the previous turn showed 7 green clicks + 1 yellow click. Before that, in an earlier turn, I had clicked the green ring once (the probe "click the center of the green block" was actually (21,45)?). The carried-over world model said "Probe: click the center of the green block." The first action of the previous sequence was MOUSE(21,45) ×7 — those were the green ring clicks. And the L increase was: 5→26 = 21 = 7×3. So all 7 worked.
Then the yellow click (44,24) once → L 5→8 ✓ worked. Then 6 more times → L 8→26 ✓, and the level was cleared.
So in level 1, every ring click worked immediately. Here, the orange ring click only changed the HUD. So the ring is not the trigger here (or the effect is different).
New idea: maybe the purple shapes are the interactive objects. The T-shape and the vertical bar. Clicking them might move/rotate them. And the goal might be to align the purple vertical bar with something, or to connect the T to the bar? The plus at (31,52) is near the right end of the T's horizontal bar (the bar spans columns 33-56, rows 9-11; the plus is at (31,52), below the bar).
Or maybe the piece moves when you click the plus? Or the piece moves toward the clicked cell?
Let me try clicking the purple vertical bar (30,43) and the purple T (10,45).
